lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: The moon, hero! We're ON THE MOON. Which, it turns out, has been privately owned since a shady auction in the Fourth Age.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Who buys the MOON?

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Someone who charges the OCEAN rent for using gravity. The rabbits called us. It's bad.

lines.speaker: The LLC
lines.text: THIS ENTITY ACKNOWLEDGES YOUR COMPLAINT. THIS ENTITY WILL RESPOND WITHIN 6-8 BUSINESS EONS.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: How do you fight an LLC?

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Aim for the registered agent!
The penthouse crater. A throne of security deposits. The Moonlord counts tide-rent by candlelight, though he owns the biggest light in the night sky.

lines.speaker: The Moonlord
lines.text: Ah. The rabbits' little "advocates". The moon is MINE. I have a deed. It's laminated.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Laminated by WHOM? We know The Laminator personally, and he keeps RECORDS.

lines.speaker: The Moonlord
lines.text: ...EVICTION PROCEEDINGS BEGIN NOW.

lines.speaker: The Moonlord
lines.text: Fine... FINE... the moon goes... to the rabbits...
The rabbits establish the Lunar Cooperative. First act: rice cakes for all. Second act: the tides ride free, forever.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Best view I've ever had of home.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Don't get cozy. Our next stop is... hmm. The travel form just says "HELL (CUSTOMER SERVICE DIVISION)". Neat!
The Rice Cake Commons. A tenant meeting is in session. The moon rabbits pound mochi and grievances in equal measure.

lines.speaker: Moon Rabbit Elder
lines.text: The wolf sent moon-mail. He says: "Withhold the rent. Hold the line. Solidarity, even in low gravity."

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Fenris organized the MOON by POST. I want to study him. I want to BE him.
An old light flickers on across the crater. A face appears in it — tired, kind, luminous.

lines.speaker: Man in the Moon
lines.text: I ran this rock for ten thousand years. Soft light. Free tides. Then I retire ONE eon and someone installs a LANDLORD?

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: We're here to fix that.

lines.speaker: Man in the Moon
lines.text: Then prove it, young light. Old moon rules: we spar first, THEN I believe you.
The penthouse crater elevator. The buttons read: LOBBY, MEZZANINE, DARK SIDE, and PROFIT.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Everything the rabbits pounded, he taxed. Everything the tides moved, he metered. Tonight the moon goes BACK to the moon, hero.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Press PROFIT.
